mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM book) AS book_total, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM book WHERE status = 1) AS book_active, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM book WHERE status = 0) AS book_deleted, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM book_category WHERE status = 1) AS category_total, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM book_chapter ch JOIN book b ON b.id = ch.book_id AND b.status = 1 WHERE ch.status = 1) AS chapter_total, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ch.word_count), 0) FROM book_chapter ch JOIN book b ON b.id = ch.book_id AND b.status = 1 WHERE ch.status = 1) AS word_total, (SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(ch.word_count)), 0) FROM book_chapter ch JOIN book b ON b.id = ch.book_id AND b.status = 1 WHERE ch.status = 1) AS avg_chapter_words, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(t.seconds), 0) FROM book_reading_time t JOIN book b ON b.id = t.book_id AND b.status = 1) AS reading_seconds_total, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.user_uuid) FROM book_reading_time t JOIN book b ON b.id = t.book_id AND b.status = 1) AS reader_count, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.book_id) FROM book_reading_time t JOIN book b ON b.id = t.book_id AND b.status = 1) AS book_read_count

SELECT c.name AS name, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS book_count, COUNT(ch.id) AS chapter_count, COALESCE(SUM(ch.word_count), 0) AS word_count FROM book_category c LEFT JOIN book b ON b.category_id = c.id AND b.status = 1 LEFT JOIN book_chapter ch ON ch.book_id = b.id AND ch.status = 1 WHERE c.status = 1 GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY word_count DESC, c.sort_order

SELECT b.title AS title, COUNT(ch.id) AS chapter_count, COALESCE(SUM(ch.word_count), 0) AS word_count FROM book b LEFT JOIN book_chapter ch ON ch.book_id = b.id AND ch.status = 1 WHERE b.status = 1 GROUP BY b.id, b.title ORDER BY word_count DESC, b.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT '1千字以下' AS label, COUNT(*) AS item_count FROM book_chapter WHERE status = 1 AND word_count < 1000 AND book_id IN (SELECT id FROM book WHERE status = 1) UNION ALL SELECT '1千-5千字', COUNT(*) FROM book_chapter WHERE status = 1 AND word_count >= 1000 AND word_count < 5000 AND book_id IN (SELECT id FROM book WHERE status = 1) UNION ALL SELECT '5千-2万字', COUNT(*) FROM book_chapter WHERE status = 1 AND word_count >= 5000 AND word_count < 20000 AND book_id IN (SELECT id FROM book WHERE status = 1) UNION ALL SELECT '2万字以上', COUNT(*) FROM book_chapter WHERE status = 1 AND word_count >= 20000 AND book_id IN (SELECT id FROM book WHERE status = 1)

SELECT t.stat_date AS stat_date, SUM(t.seconds) AS seconds FROM book_reading_time t JOIN book b ON b.id = t.book_id AND b.status = 1 WHERE t.stat_date >= #{fromDate} GROUP BY t.stat_date ORDER BY t.stat_date

SELECT AVG(ratio) FROM ( SELECT e.user_uuid, e.book_id, COUNT(DISTINCT e.chapter_id) * 1.0 / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM book_chapter c WHERE c.book_id = e.book_id AND c.status = 1), 0) AS ratio FROM book_reading_event e JOIN book b ON b.id = e.book_id AND b.status = 1 GROUP BY e.user_uuid, e.book_id ) t
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO book_reading_time (user_uuid, book_id, stat_date, seconds, update_time) VALUES (#{userUuid}, #{bookId}, #{statDate}, #{seconds}, #{now})
INSERT INTO book_reading_event (user_uuid, book_id, chapter_id, event_time) VALUES (#{userUuid}, #{bookId}, #{chapterId}, #{eventTime})
